card.name: Time unit after "a" and rounding verbs
card.fires_on: The time word right after "a" in rate phrases such as "a year" or "once a week". Also the verbs "Round" or "give" that start an instruction sentence.

modes.label: Time unit after a
modes.description: Year, week or while following "a" in a per-time rate.
modes.example: At the current production rate of about 1.1 billion tons a<< year>>, this is enough coal to last for

modes.label: Round at sentence start
modes.description: The verb Round opening a dose or volume calculation step.

modes.label: Give after a condition
modes.description: The verb give starting the main clause after an if-condition about a course.
modes.example: If a nadir as defined in the table above has occurred,<< give>> the next course 28 days after
